headline: The recovered Snapchat files are raising serious questions about what happened after Nolan
body: The recovered Snapchat files are raising serious questions about what happened after Nolan Wells disappeared. According to the creator who says they reviewed all 292 pages, many of the conversations appeared focused less on Nolan and more on public image, his family’s decisions, their lawyer, and how the group would be perceived. One message shown even asks, “Is Nolan’s funeral gonna be at the coliseum” before his body had been found.

source_caption_text:
The recovered Snapchat files are raising serious questions about what happened after Nolan Wells disappeared. According to the creator who says they reviewed all 292 pages, many of the conversations appeared focused less on Nolan and more on public image, his family’s decisions, their lawyer, and how the group would be perceived.

One message shown even asks, “Is Nolan’s funeral gonna be at the coliseum” before his body had been found.

None of this alone proves anyone committed a crime — but people following the case are questioning what these messages reveal about the group’s behavior and what they may have known at the time.
